title: AutoCompress: Automated Hardware-Guided Model Compression
abstract: arXiv:2611.08290v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM pruning must preserve quality while meeting hardware- and workload-specific constraints on latency, throughput, and memory. Existing pruning workflows often target parameter counts, requiring practitioners to manually select model sizes that meet latency, throughput, and GPU memory limits. However, parameter count alone does not predict these metrics, which depend on the model architecture, workload, hardware, and serving engine. We introduce AutoCompress, a hardware-guided compression framework that directly incorporates such constraints into differentiable architecture search. AutoCompress jointly optimizes global and per-layer structure to produce heterogeneous architectures, guided by serving-engine cost models validated against end-to-end latency, throughput, and memory measurements. translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）剪枝必须在满足硬件和工作负载特定的延迟、吞吐量和内存约束的同时保持模型质量。现有的剪枝流程通常以参数数量为目标，要求从业者手动选择满足延迟、吞吐量和GPU内存限制的模型规模。然而，仅凭参数数量并不能预测这些指标，因为这些指标取决于模型架构、工作负载、硬件和服务引擎。我们提出了AutoCompress，这是一个硬件引导的压缩框架，它将此类约束直接纳入可微架构搜索中。AutoCompress联合优化全局和逐层结构以生成异构架构，其优化过程由经过端到端延迟、吞吐量和内存实测验证的服务引擎成本模型引导。我们在长上下文本地编码、批量数据中心服务和延迟敏感的游戏内交互场景中评估了AutoCompress。与标准（基线相比，……原文在此处截断）
tldr: AutoCompress是一个硬件引导的模型压缩框架，它将延迟、吞吐量和内存等硬件与工作负载约束直接纳入可微架构搜索，联合优化全局与逐层结构以生成异构压缩架构，并利用经过实测验证的服务引擎成本模型引导整个优化过程。
